app.features.municipal-regional: Enter your address or click the map to see every ballot voted on there – mayor, municipal council, regional president and regional council – with the candidates in ballot order, their parties and the results of the {year} elections: each candidate's votes and share, the winners and the turnout, on the ballots and on the map, down to the polling districts. Where known, the map also marks who held each office at the time of the election and with what share of the vote they had won it, and for the candidates researched it adds notes on their career and controversies, each linked to its source. It covers every municipality and constituency in Slovakia, with no ads and no tracking.
app.features.municipal: Enter your address or click the map to see every ballot voted on there – mayor and municipal council – with the candidates in ballot order, their parties and the results of the {year} municipal elections: each candidate's votes and share, the winners and the turnout, on the ballots and on the map, down to the polling districts where the Statistical Office counted them. It covers every municipality and constituency in Slovakia, with no ads and no tracking.
app.features.regional: Enter your address or click the map to see every ballot voted on there – regional president and regional council – with the candidates in ballot order, their parties and the results of the {year} regional elections: each candidate's votes and share, the winners and the turnout, on the ballots and on the map, down to the polling districts. It covers every municipality and constituency in Slovakia, with no ads and no tracking.
app.features.by-election: Enter your address or click the map to see where by-elections are held and which ballots are voted on there – mayor, municipal council, regional president or regional council – with the candidates in ballot order, their parties and the results of the {year} by-elections: each candidate's votes and share, the winners and the turnout, on the ballots and on the map, down to the polling districts. It covers every municipality and region in Slovakia where a by-election is held, with no ads and no tracking.
app.features.presidential: See the ballot of the {year} presidential election, the same across Slovakia, with the candidates in ballot order, their age, occupation and residence, and the results of each round: each candidate's votes and share, who goes on to the second round and who is elected, and the turnout – for the whole country and on the map by region, district, municipality and polling district. Enter your address or click the map to see the figures where you vote. No ads and no tracking.
app.features.referendum: See the questions of the {year} referendum, worded as on the ballot, and its results: the yes and no votes and their shares, the turnout against the half of the eligible voters needed, and whether the referendum is valid – for the whole country and on the map by region, district, municipality and polling district. Enter your address or click the map to see the figures where you vote. No ads and no tracking.
app.features.parliament: See the ballot of the {year} election to the National Council of the Slovak Republic: every party in ballot order with its list of candidates, the threshold each needs to win seats and how many preference votes a voter may give. Once counted, each party's votes, share and seats, the preference votes of its candidates and who is elected, and the turnout – for the whole country and on the map by region, district, municipality and polling district. Enter your address or click the map to see the figures where you vote. No ads and no tracking.
app.features.european: See the ballot of the {year} European Parliament election in Slovakia: every party in ballot order with its list of candidates, the threshold each needs to win seats and how many preference votes a voter may give. Once counted, each party's votes, share and seats, the preference votes of its candidates and who is elected, and the turnout – for the whole country and on the map by region, district, municipality and polling district. Enter your address or click the map to see the figures where you vote. No ads and no tracking.

site.features: {site} maps Slovakia's elections since {since}: the municipal and regional elections and by-elections, the presidential elections, the referendums, and the elections to the National Council of the Slovak Republic and the European Parliament. Each election has a page of its own with its ballots, its candidates and, once counted, its results.

about.disclaimer.title: Disclaimers
about.method.title: How it works
about.method.candidates: The MV SR candidate lists carry no municipality codes, so municipalities are matched by name within their okres (district). Candidacies of one person in several contests are merged by municipality, name and age.
about.method.map: The map is drawn directly from the ZBGIS municipal boundaries at several levels of detail, without a base map from other servers. The regional council constituencies and the city council constituencies of Bratislava and Košice consist of whole municipalities and city districts, as set by the decisions of the regions and cities. The countries around Slovakia are drawn coarser, from Natural Earth, for orientation only. The faint roads, railways, rivers and lakes under the colours, simplified for each zoom, and the outlines of the buildings drawn as you zoom in close, also for orientation only, come from OpenStreetMap.
about.method.map_municipal: The map is drawn directly from the ZBGIS municipal boundaries at several levels of detail, without a base map from other servers. The city council constituencies of Bratislava and Košice consist of whole city districts, as set by the decisions of the cities. The countries around Slovakia are drawn coarser, from Natural Earth, for orientation only. The faint roads, railways, rivers and lakes under the colours, simplified for each zoom, and the outlines of the buildings drawn as you zoom in close, also for orientation only, come from OpenStreetMap.
about.method.map_regional: The map is drawn directly from the ZBGIS municipal boundaries at several levels of detail, without a base map from other servers. The regional council constituencies consist of whole municipalities and city districts, as set by the decisions of the regions. The countries around Slovakia are drawn coarser, from Natural Earth, for orientation only. The faint roads, railways, rivers and lakes under the colours, simplified for each zoom, and the outlines of the buildings drawn as you zoom in close, also for orientation only, come from OpenStreetMap.
about.method.addresses: The address search uses the MV SR address register. Addresses whose point lies more than 100 m outside their municipality are shown without a location.
about.method.obvody: Municipalities with one council constituency have it assigned directly. Municipalities and city districts with several constituencies define them in their own resolutions, by streets, house numbers or parts of the municipality. An AI agent transcribed these resolutions from the municipalities' websites into rules, which were checked to put every address of the municipality into exactly one constituency; the resolutions are linked below. Where a resolution has not been processed yet, all constituencies are shown. The number of seats comes from these resolutions; a council with one constituency whose {year} number is not known yet shows the number elected at the previous elections (Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic), labelled as such.
about.method.approximate: The boundaries on the map are simplified and meant for orientation. The boundaries between the constituencies within a municipality are drawn around the houses that belong to them (dashed: approximate) and smoothed into plausible areas, so a few houses may lie in the area of a neighbouring constituency; the address search gives the constituency of the address itself. A few municipalities have published only the names of their constituencies (such as the lower and upper end of the village), not which houses belong to them; their constituencies are our estimate from the map, and their ballots say so.
about.method.obvody_adopted: In {n} municipalities no usable {year} document places the addresses in the council constituencies, so they are drawn with the borders of {source}, the nearest vote in time with the same constituencies and seats: {list}. Treat them as indicative only; the notes on each say so.
about.method.okrsky_adopted: In {n} municipalities no usable {year} document places the addresses in the polling districts, so they are drawn with the borders of {source}, the nearest vote in time with as many polling districts (in each constituency) and, where known, similar numbers of voters: {list}. Treat them as indicative only; the notes on each say so.
about.method.incumbents: Who held an office at the time of the election was rebuilt from the final results of the {previous} elections and of every municipal by-election since (Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic) and matched to the candidates by municipality or region, name and age; later changes are not known. Substitutes who took up a vacated seat and departures without a by-election are missing, and a candidate whose surname changed is not matched, so the chair mark (“held this office at the time of the election”) may be incomplete. How each office holder won the seat comes from the same final results, counted in the unit where the seat was won: the municipality for a mayor, the region for a regional president, the council constituency of that election (or the whole municipality if it had one) for a councillor. The share for a mayor or president is of the valid ballots; for a council, where each voter could vote for several candidates, it is of the voters with a valid ballot, so the shares of one constituency add up to more than 100 %. The share of all registered voters and the turnout (voters who took part, of those registered) are given too.
about.method.research: Candidate research: for each candidate, AI agents search the sites on the list below, separately for each research language (sources in Slovak, in Hungarian and so on), decide which pages are about the candidate rather than someone with the same name, and report each relevant fact as a finding: a one-sentence claim, a verbatim quote and the page it comes from. Findings are sorted as career, serious controversy (charges brought by the police or prosecutors, a court decision against the candidate or another serious matter an authority has established) or allegations and disputes (claims the candidate denies or no one has confirmed, cases that ended in the candidate's favour, and lesser matters); in doubt, a finding goes among the allegations and disputes. Every research result first says what was searched (which sites, and when) and only then what was found; nothing found there is no proof that nothing exists. A candidate not researched yet is marked as such: no research has been done on them.
about.method.research_check: Every page cited is downloaded and kept, and a finding is accepted only if its quote appears word for word in the kept copy and the page names the candidate; the copy is linked next to the original. The claims are written by artificial intelligence and no one checks them one by one; a quote in a language other than that of the interface comes with a machine translation that no one has checked. The research covers only the sites on the list and may miss things: finding nothing does not mean there is nothing.

about.allowlist.title: Sources for candidate research
about.allowlist.intro: AI agents researching candidates may cite only these sites and their subdomains:
about.research.title: Research coverage
about.research.unresearched: Candidates not counted here have not been researched yet: no sources have been searched about them.
about.category.official: Official sites and public registers (plus the official sites of municipalities and regions)
about.allowlist.rule: Media selection rule: in each country, brands are ranked by online weekly reach in the Reuters Institute Digital News Report 2026; those with a net trust (trust minus distrust) of at least +5 points are kept and the top ten are taken (fewer where fewer brands qualify); on equal reach, higher net trust wins. Ukraine is not covered by the report, so the Institute of Mass Information's High Quality List (first half of 2026) is the credibility filter there; sites with a reach figure in the Internews Ukraine 2025 survey come first. Slovak media in Hungarian are the news sites measured in the Forum Minority Research Institute's 2021 survey of Hungarians in Slovakia, ordered by readership.
about.allowlist.exclude: Sections with user-generated content are excluded: sites with “{hosts}” in their host name and pages with a “{paths}” segment in their path.
about.allowlist.blocklist: Sites on the konspiratori.sk list are always blocked, even if they match the list above (snapshot of the list from {date}, sites: {n}):
about.repository: The source code is on {github}, where you can also report mistakes.
about.software.title: Software
about.software: The site uses the Leaflet (BSD-2-Clause license), Preact, htm and qrcode-generator (MIT license) libraries. It loads nothing from other servers: no map tiles, fonts or analytics.

about.inputs.results_lists: Candidates and results of the municipal and regional elections, Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic
about.method.candidates_susr: The candidates come from the Statistical Office's tables of the final results, which give the municipality of each contest by its code. Candidacies of one person in several contests are merged by municipality, name and age.
about.method.candidates_country: The candidates come from the tables of the Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic. Their municipality of residence is matched by name where exactly one municipality has it; otherwise it is shown as written.
about.method.candidates_curated: The candidates are transcribed by hand from the official lists; municipalities are matched by name.
about.method.map_country: The map is drawn directly from the ZBGIS municipal boundaries at several levels of detail, without a base map from other servers. The countries around Slovakia are drawn coarser, from Natural Earth, for orientation only. The faint roads, railways, rivers and lakes under the colours, simplified for each zoom, and the outlines of the buildings drawn as you zoom in close, also for orientation only, come from OpenStreetMap.
about.method.results_country: The results come from the tables of the Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic for all of Slovakia, its municipalities and polling districts. The results of regions and districts are the sums of their municipalities'.
about.latest.title: What comes from {latest}
about.latest.intro: Not all data of the {year} elections survive. Where something is missing, it is either taken from the {latest} elections or said to be unknown, as listed here; the ballots and the map say so at each place concerned.
about.latest.boundaries: Boundaries: the map draws the ZBGIS boundaries of {zbgis}. Those of {date} (kept as a record, not drawn) differ in {n} municipalities, where land has moved between neighbours or along the state border: {list}; elsewhere only by centimetres to metres of redrawing. Every address keeps its municipality.
about.latest.obvody: Council constituencies: {several} municipalities elected their council in several constituencies; {own} of them are drawn from their own {year} documents.
about.latest.obvody_reused: {n} are drawn with the {latest} rules, as no {year} document was found but the layout provably matches (the same constituencies and seats, and in each the same polling districts with about as many voters): {list}.
about.latest.obvody_unknown: In {n} the {year} borders are not known, as no document setting them was found; their ballots list every constituency.
about.latest.obvody_unknown_partly: In {n} the {year} borders are not known: for {not_found} of them no document setting them was found, the others have not been searched for yet. Their ballots list every constituency.
about.latest.okrsky: Polling districts: {several} municipalities voted in several polling districts. {drawn} have them drawn; in {unknown} they are not known, so their results by polling district are not placed on the map.
about.latest.okrsky_reused: The polling districts of {n} municipalities are taken from the {latest} documents, as no {year} document was found but they match in number and voters.
about.latest.okrsky_copied: The polling districts of {n} municipalities are drawn from the documents of the municipal elections of {years}, the nearest in time where they match in number and voters; the {year} documents were not searched for.
about.latest.okrsky_referendum: Those of {n} municipalities are drawn from the municipality's document for a referendum held soon after the elections: either it says they stayed as they were, or no document of the elections was found.
about.latest.obvody_dated: Of those drawn, {n} come from documents that state no date. They are dated only approximately: by a copy kept in the Internet Archive or a posting date before the elections, or because they name the elections. Their ballots say so.
about.latest.okrsky_dated: The polling districts of {n} municipalities come from documents that state no date. They are dated only approximately: by a copy kept in the Internet Archive or a posting date before the elections, or because they name the elections. Their ballots say so.
about.latest.obvody_supplemented: Of those drawn, {n} have part of their borders from a later source (the {latest} rules or a later document of the municipality), where their {year} document does not place every address; the {year} borders may have differed there. Their ballots say so.
about.latest.okrsky_supplemented: The polling districts of {n} municipalities have part of their borders from a later source (a later election's or referendum's document, or another later document of the municipality), where their {year} document does not place every address; the {year} borders may have differed there. Their ballots say so.
